  9+2+3+2+1+3+2+9+2 = 33, odd positions 6+5+6+1+1+6+3+1+1 = 30, difference 3. ✓

  Mod 7 (using 10⁶ ≡ 1, group in sixes): A ≡ 3, B ≡ 1, so product ≡ 3. Answer: 635269 + 631112 + 121932 = 1,388,313 → 1 + 388,313
  = 388,314 = 7×55,473 + 3. ✓

  Magnitude: 9.8765×10⁸ × 1.2346×10⁸ ≈ 1.2193×10¹⁷ — an 18-digit number beginning 1219. ✓

  ---
  Final answer

  $$987{,}654{,}321 \times 123{,}456{,}789 = \mathbf{121{,}932{,}631{,}112{,}635{,}269}$$
